events.name: Halloween
events.intro: The lights are low and something keeps rolling pumpkins into chat.

drop.name: pumpkin
lines: Something left a pumpkin on the doorstep.
A pumpkin fell off the back of a hay cart.
This pumpkin is glowing. Probably fine.
A suspiciously heavy pumpkin just appeared.
Someone carved a face into this one. It's looking at you.
A pumpkin drifted in on the fog.
The front desk bell rang by itself. There's a pumpkin on the counter.

events.name: Winter Fest
events.intro: It's snowing in the lobby and nobody is fixing the roof.

drop.name: snowflake
lines: The window's open again. A snowflake blew in.
A perfect snowflake landed on the keyboard.
A snowflake is melting on the front desk. Quick.
This one fell off a passing sleigh.
The heating is off and it's snowing indoors.
A snowflake the size of a coin just floated by.
